rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: movedown:1.6: can: p196-strip0.jpg header prints the metre 8.7.8.7.8.7.7., so lines 6 and 7 sing 7 syllables each (p196-strip800.jpg system 3 end and p196-strip1600.jpg system 4, stanza 1's row). The capital on "Peace" (a name of Christ) does not tell the lines apart, but the change makes them 6 and 8 syllables, which the metre breaks. moveup:1.6: can: p196-strip0.jpg header prints the metre 8.7.8.7.8.7.7., so lines 6 and 7 sing 7 syllables each (p196-strip800.jpg system 3 end and p196-strip1600.jpg system 4, stanza 1's row). "Thou" is printed with a capital anyway (a name of God), but the change makes the lines 8 and 6 syllables, which the metre breaks.
